item.title: As Uber's Profit Margins Grow, Workers Make Less and Less
item.description: Uber finally turned a profit in 2023. How did they do it? By raising prices 65% in 5 years while taking a bigger cut from drivers.

item.title: This Billionaire Family is Suffocating Rural America
item.description: Just 4 companies control almost all the fertilizer in America. It's about to get worse.

item.description: We dug into the real reason all of our clothes are getting worse.

item.title: Exclusive Interview With President Joe Biden
item.description: We sat down with President Joe Biden to talk about his economic legacy — and whether he thinks he went far enough to help working people. He said he spent his career trying to overturn trickle-down economic theory. “What happened? Corporate America got greedy.” The post Exclusive Interview With President Joe Biden appeared first on More Perfect Union.

item.title: Trump Says He Will Save American Jobs. John Deere Is Calling His Bluff.
item.description: John Deere has announced more than 1500 layoffs in the last year. Deere and Case New Holland used to employ generations of union workers across the midwest. Now they’re slashing American jobs and moving to Mexico. We investigated what’s behind it — and how to bring those jobs back. The post Trump Says He Will Save American Jobs. John Deere Is Calling His Bluff. appeared first on More Perfect Union.

item.title: We Put 5 Young Men In a Room: What They Said Will Surprise You
item.description: Democrats spent $20 million trying to figure out men. We decided to just talk to some. Some of what they said might make you uncomfortable. But if politicians want to actually reach working class men, they need to have more messy conversations like this one. The post We Put 5 Young Men In a Room: What They Said Will Surprise You appeared first on More Perfect Union.

item.title: Watch our Emmy-winning video: Elliott County Voted for Democrats For 144 Years. Then Came Trump...
item.description: Elliott County, Kentucky voted for Democrats for 144 years straight. Then, the county flipped to Trump…while simultaneously voting for Democratic Governor Andy Beshear. So what does this county have to tell us about this political moment? John Russell and Nehemiah Stark went down to find out. The post Watch our Emmy-winning video: Elliott County Voted for Democrats For 144 Years. Then Came Trump… appeared first on More Perfect Union.

item.title: We Investigated Hundreds of Trump Donors. What We Found Will Shock You.
item.description: Trump used to say that Big Tech is a horrible thing for our country. Now, he’s cozy with Mark Zuckerberg, Tim Cook, and Silicon Valley. What changed? We analyzed all the donors to Trump’s inauguration and uncovered a massive corruption and influence-buying scheme. The post We Investigated Hundreds of Trump Donors.
